active.prompt: Why is the older version worth keeping for tomorrow?
active.promptZh: 為什麼值得保留舊版供明天使用？

options.text: It automatically saves the error logs.
options.zh: 它會自動儲存錯誤記錄。
options.whyZh: 錯誤記錄須先另外匯出。

options.text: It showed the same problem on the spare unit.
options.zh: 它在備用機上出現相同問題。
options.whyZh: 備用機上的舊版仍能運作。

options.text: It provides a working fallback for the customer demo.
options.zh: 它能為客戶展示提供可用的備案。
options.whyZh: 更新後展示機故障，但備用機上的舊版可用，隔天早上的展示可用舊版當備案。

options.text: It lets the team skip the investigation.
options.zh: 它能讓團隊省去調查。
options.whyZh: 還要留一台故障機供後續調查。

active.explanationZh: 更新後展示機故障，但備用機上的舊版可用，隔天早上的展示可用舊版當備案。
active.evidence: Three demonstration units stopped responding after yesterday's firmware update. The older version still works on the spare unit. | Yes. Should I restore the earlier version afterward? We have a customer demonstration tomorrow morning. | Yes, once the logs are saved. Keep one failed unit unchanged for further investigation.

vocabulary.note: 原做法失效時可採用的替代方案。

active.prompt: An engineer wants to restore a unit now. What would that risk losing?
active.promptZh: 工程師想立刻還原其中一台機器。這樣可能失去什麼？

options.text: Evidence the software team needs to recreate the failure.
options.zh: 軟體團隊重現故障所需的證據。
options.whyZh: 要先匯出錯誤記錄給軟體團隊重現問題；未儲存即還原，可能會失去這些證據。

options.text: The older version that works on the spare unit.
options.zh: 備用機上仍可運作的舊版。
options.whyZh: 備用機已有可用舊版，還原一台故障機不會改變備用機。

options.text: The customer’s reservation for tomorrow.
options.zh: 客戶明天的預約。
options.whyZh: 對話未說還原會取消展示。

options.text: The ability to keep any other unit unchanged.
options.zh: 保留其他機器狀態不變的機會。
options.whyZh: 留一台不動是另一項要求，還原某台不代表其他台也一定會被改動。

active.explanationZh: 要先匯出錯誤記錄給軟體團隊重現問題；未儲存即還原，可能會失去這些證據。
active.evidence: Three demonstration units stopped responding after yesterday's firmware update. The older version still works on the spare unit. | Before we change anything, can you export the error logs? The software team needs them to reproduce the issue. | Yes, once the logs are saved. Keep one failed unit unchanged for further investigation.

vocabulary.note: 把設備或軟體恢復到原先的版本或狀態。

active.prompt: What should happen to one failed unit?
active.promptZh: 其中一台故障機應如何處理？

options.text: Leave it as it failed for investigation, even if the others are restored after logging.
options.zh: 即使記錄儲存後還原其他機器，也讓這一台保持故障狀態供調查。
options.whyZh: 即使其他故障機在記錄存好後可以還原，這台仍原樣保留給軟體團隊調查。

options.text: Restore it before exporting logs, then reserve it for investigation.
options.zh: 先還原這台再匯出記錄，之後留它調查。
options.whyZh: 變更前須先匯出記錄；被保留的這台還不能先還原。

options.text: Keep it unchanged only until the logs are exported, then restore it as well.
options.zh: 只保留到記錄匯出為止，之後也把這台還原。
options.whyZh: 保留故障機是為了後續調查，並非只留到記錄儲存完。

options.text: Repair it immediately and keep the working spare unchanged instead.
options.zh: 立刻修好這台，改保留可用備用機不動。
options.whyZh: 應保留的是故障機，不是原本就能用的備用機。

active.explanationZh: 即使其他故障機在記錄存好後可以還原，這台仍原樣保留給軟體團隊調查。
active.evidence: Before we change anything, can you export the error logs? | Yes, once the logs are saved. Keep one failed unit unchanged for further investigation.

vocabulary.note: 記錄錯誤事件與狀態，協助除錯。
在可控制的條件下再次觸發相同問題。

active.prompt: What can the team do on Monday?
active.promptZh: 團隊星期一可以做什麼？

options.text: Inspect the housings only after the new fixture is checked.
options.zh: 等新治具檢查完才檢查外殼。
options.whyZh: 檢查外殼不需治具，星期一即可進行。

options.text: Inspect the housings and assemble the full batch that day.
options.zh: 當天檢查外殼並完成整批組裝。
options.whyZh: 外殼可先檢查，但星期一治具還沒準備好，不能完成整批組裝。

options.text: Inspect the housings without the fixture and leave assembly for later.
options.zh: 不用治具先檢查外殼，組裝留待之後。
options.whyZh: 外殼檢查不依賴治具，可先進行；組裝要等治具準備好且完成檢查。

options.text: Inspect the housings using the new fixture as soon as it arrives that day.
options.zh: 當天治具一到就用它檢查外殼。
options.whyZh: 治具星期二才會準備好；外殼檢查也不需要它。

active.explanationZh: 外殼檢查不依賴治具，可先進行；組裝要等治具準備好且完成檢查。
active.evidence: Can the team start with the housing inspection on Monday? That does not require the fixture. ... Assembly can move to Wednesday, after the fixture has been checked.

vocabulary.note: 正式量產前的小批次製作，用於驗證設計與製程準備。
本題用於組裝的定位或輔助工具。

options.text: Treat the correct packing list as approval and start relabeling.
options.zh: 把正確的裝箱清單視為核准，開始重貼標籤。
options.whyZh: 裝箱清單正確不等於品管已核准更正。

options.text: Check the print history and relabel as soon as an old template is found.
options.zh: 查明列印紀錄後，一發現用過舊版型就重貼。
options.whyZh: 即使查到舊版型，重貼前仍須取得品管核准。

options.text: Relabel to match the packing list and tell quality afterward.
options.zh: 先依裝箱清單重貼，之後再通知品管。
options.whyZh: 品管核准必須在重貼之前，不是事後通知。

options.text: Have quality approve the correction even though the packing list is already right.
options.zh: 即使裝箱清單本來就正確，仍要先由品管核准更正。
options.whyZh: 清單正確可用於確認差異，但重貼前仍需由品管核准更正。

active.explanationZh: 清單正確可用於確認差異，但重貼前仍需由品管核准更正。
active.evidence: The list is correct. The label printer may have used an old template. ... Do not relabel anything until the quality team approves the correction.

vocabulary.note: 列示包裝內貨物與數量的文件。
在等待確認或處置期間暫時放置物品的區域。

active.prompt: What does the woman suggest may be the cause?
active.promptZh: 女方認為可能的原因是什麼？

options.text: The server is working, but his account can open files without adding them.
options.zh: 伺服器正常，但他的帳號可查看檔案、不能新增檔案。
options.whyZh: 他開得了資料夾卻不能上傳，且伺服器運作中，符合只有讀取權限。

options.text: His account can add files, but the server outage prevents it for now.
options.zh: 他的帳號可以新增檔案，但伺服器停機暫時擋住上傳。
options.whyZh: 女方明說伺服器正常，沒有說帳號已具備寫入權限。

options.text: His account cannot view the folder, but it can submit the report.
options.zh: 他的帳號不能查看資料夾，但可以提交報告。
options.whyZh: 實際症狀相反：可以開啟資料夾，卻不能上傳。

options.text: The server is online, but the folder already contains the approved report.
options.zh: 伺服器正常，但資料夾裡已經有核准過的那份報告。
options.whyZh: 對話只提到經理請他加入報告，沒有說報告已存在。

active.explanationZh: 他開得了資料夾卻不能上傳，且伺服器運作中，符合只有讀取權限。
active.evidence: I can open the project folder, but I cannot upload the validation report. Is the server down? ... The server is running. Your account may have read-only access.

vocabulary.note: 可讀取但不能修改或新增內容的權限。
允許新增或修改資料的權限。

active.prompt: What is the main trade-off between the two chamber options?
active.promptZh: 兩種測試箱方案主要要取捨什麼？

options.text: Bringing fewer samples or running a shorter test.
options.zh: 少帶一些樣品，或縮短測試時間。
options.whyZh: 兩種方案都沒有提到縮短原定測試時間。

options.text: Testing sooner or fitting all the samples.
options.zh: 提早開始測試，或容納所有樣品。
options.whyZh: 小測試箱週三就能用，但裝不下全部十二件樣品；大測試箱能容納全數，但要等到週五。

options.text: Starting on Friday or getting more time in the same chamber.
options.zh: 週五開始，或延長同一台測試箱的使用時間。
options.whyZh: 提早開始必須改用小測試箱，不是延長同一台的使用時間。

options.text: Keeping the chamber available or changing the test plan.
options.zh: 維持測試箱可用，或修改測試計畫。
options.whyZh: 對話比較的是容量與可用時間，沒有說要修改計畫。

active.explanationZh: 小測試箱週三就能用，但裝不下全部十二件樣品；大測試箱能容納全數，但要等到週五。
active.evidence: Another team has booked it through Thursday. You could begin Friday morning, or use the smaller chamber on Wednesday. | The smaller one cannot hold all twelve samples. Let us choose Friday, and I will notify the project manager about the revised completion date.

vocabulary.note: 選擇一項好處時，必須放棄另一項好處。

active.prompt: If all samples must be tested together, why would the original completion date change?
active.promptZh: 如果所有樣品必須一起測試，為什麼原定完成日期會變？

options.text: The team plans to add more samples.
options.zh: 團隊打算增加樣品。
options.whyZh: 樣品數量仍是十二件。

options.text: The test plan must be rewritten at check-in.
options.zh: 報到時要重寫測試計畫。
options.whyZh: 報到時只須帶測試計畫。

options.text: The smaller chamber needs extra setup.
options.zh: 小測試箱需要額外設定。
options.whyZh: 小測試箱的問題是容量不足，不是設定時間。

options.text: The full test cannot start on the originally requested day.
options.zh: 全數樣品無法在原本要求的那天開始測試。
options.whyZh: 原訂週三開始、測三天；容量足夠的測試箱週五才能用，因此完工日期得往後排。

active.explanationZh: 原訂週三開始、測三天；容量足夠的測試箱週五才能用，因此完工日期得往後排。
active.evidence: We need the reliability chamber for three days, starting Wednesday. Is it available? | Another team has booked it through Thursday. You could begin Friday morning, or use the smaller chamber on Wednesday. | The smaller one cannot hold all twelve samples. Let us choose Friday, and I will notify the project manager about the revised completion date.

vocabulary.note: 指預計結束整項工作或測試的日期。

options.text: The set menu stays, but the restaurant moves the booking to dinner.
options.zh: 維持套餐，但餐廳把訂位改到晚餐。
options.whyZh: 保留套餐沒錯，但仍是中午訂位，沒有改到晚餐。

options.text: The reservation stays at noon, but everyone orders separately.
options.zh: 仍在中午用餐，但改成由各人單點。
options.whyZh: 用餐時間沒變，男方也明確表示維持套餐。

options.text: The noon booking time and the set menu both stay in place.
options.zh: 中午的訂位時間與套餐都維持不變。
options.whyZh: 原本及修改後都訂中午，男方也選擇維持套餐。

options.text: The booking remains at noon and the restaurant omits all dietary notes.
options.zh: 仍維持中午訂位，餐廳不加任何飲食備註。
options.whyZh: 時間維持不變，但餐廳會註記有一位客人不能吃花生。

active.explanationZh: 原本及修改後都訂中午，男方也選擇維持套餐。
active.evidence: We will keep the set menu. ... Your revised reservation is for four at noon, under Mr. Lin.

vocabulary.note: 由餐廳組合的一套菜色。
訂位時常以姓名查詢紀錄。

active.prompt: What will the speakers keep in the schedule?

options.text: Keep the live morning presentation, and replace the line tour with slides.
options.zh: 保留上午現場簡報，用投影片取代產線參觀。
options.whyZh: 客戶指定看產線，保留的是參觀；提前寄送的是簡報投影片。

options.text: Keep only the slides in the visit agenda and drop the in-person tour.
options.zh: 參訪行程只保留投影片，取消實地參觀。
options.whyZh: 他們要保留產線實地參觀，不是只提供投影片。

options.text: Keep the assembly-line tour and send the presentation slides ahead of the visit.
options.zh: 保留產線參觀，並在參訪前寄出簡報投影片。
options.whyZh: 客戶特別想看產線，所以保留參觀；原本要做的簡報則改為事先寄送投影片。

options.text: Keep the assembly-line tour but hold the question session before lunch.
options.zh: 保留產線參觀，但把問答排在午餐前。
options.whyZh: 保留產線參觀沒錯，但問答移到午餐後，不是午餐前。

active.explanationZh: 客戶特別想看產線，所以保留參觀；原本要做的簡報則改為事先寄送投影片。
active.evidence: The client asked specifically to see the assembly line. Let us keep the tour and send the presentation slides in advance. ... I will move the question session to after lunch.

vocabulary.note: send slides in advance 指在活動前先寄出簡報。
以工作站或步驟安排產品組裝的生產線。

active.prompt: What does the woman need by three?

options.text: The names of staff assigned to guide the tour.
options.zh: 負責導覽的工作人員名單。
options.whyZh: 她接下來負責更新訪客識別證，不是安排導覽人員。

options.text: The final visitor list, so she can update the badges.
options.zh: 最後確認的訪客名單，方便她更新訪客識別證。
options.whyZh: 對方先請她更新訪客識別證，她答應後請對方三點前給最後確認的名單。

options.text: The list of people who will lead the question session.
options.zh: 負責帶領問答的人員名單。
options.whyZh: 問答會移到午餐後；她要的名單是為了更新訪客識別證。

options.text: The client’s contact list for sending the advance slides.
options.zh: 用來先寄送簡報投影片的客戶聯絡名單。
options.whyZh: 雖然會先寄投影片，但她是在答應更新訪客識別證後才要求名單。

active.explanationZh: 對方先請她更新訪客識別證，她答應後請對方三點前給最後確認的名單。
active.evidence: Can you update the visitor badges? | Yes. Please send me the final list of names before three today.

vocabulary.note: send slides in advance 指在活動前先寄出簡報。
以工作站或步驟安排產品組裝的生產線。

active.prompt: Which material may still be used?

options.text: Any individual cover without visible scratches, even from the held batch.
options.zh: 任何沒有明顯刮痕的外蓋，即使來自已停用的批次也可以。
options.whyZh: 管理的是整個受影響批次，不是只擋肉眼看得出刮痕的外蓋。

options.text: Covers from the earlier cleared batch; a clean-looking cover from the held lot still stays out.
options.zh: 可用先前通過檢驗的那批外蓋；已停用批次的外蓋即使看來沒傷也不能用。
options.whyZh: 前一批經檢驗通過可用；受影響的批次即使單件外觀無傷也不能投產。

options.text: Covers from the current batch once Purchasing schedules replacement delivery.
options.zh: 採購排定替換品交貨時程後，就可使用這次到貨的外蓋。
options.whyZh: 排定替換品交貨並不會解禁原本被停用的批次。

options.text: Both batches, provided the supplier submits a report by Tuesday.
options.zh: 只要供應商週二前提交報告，兩批都能用。
options.whyZh: 週二是供應商改善報告期限，不是兩批共同的放行期限。

active.explanationZh: 前一批經檢驗通過可用；受影響的批次即使單件外觀無傷也不能投產。
active.evidence: The affected batch has been placed on hold and will not enter production. | The earlier batch passed inspection and can still be used.

vocabulary.note: 對到貨材料或零件進行的檢查。
針對已發生問題的原因採取措施；本題要求供應商提交報告。

options.text: Assign each requester to check separately; use the label even if a seal is damaged.
options.zh: 請每位提出需求的人各自核對；封條損壞仍以箱標為準。
options.whyZh: 只須安排一名代表核對，且封條受損時不能直接採用箱標數量。

options.text: Send one representative to check with warehouse staff; use the label count only when the seal is intact.
options.zh: 安排一位代表和庫房核對；只有封條完好才採用箱標數量。
options.whyZh: 組長指定一人與庫房核對。封條完整的箱子可用標示數量，封條受損者不可直接照箱標。

options.text: Assign one representative to check with warehouse staff; use all label counts, including boxes with broken seals.
options.zh: 安排一位代表和庫房核對；所有箱子都照箱標，包括封條破損的箱子。
options.whyZh: 人員分工正確，但不能把破損封條的箱標直接當成正確數量。

options.text: Send separate representatives for each box and verify only counts that already match their labels.
options.zh: 每箱各派一位代表，只核對與箱標已相符的數量。
options.whyZh: 不是每箱各派人；也不能把核對範圍限於看似相符的箱標。

active.explanationZh: 組長指定一人與庫房核對。封條完整的箱子可用標示數量，封條受損者不可直接照箱標。
active.evidence: From noon to four, we will handle safety emergencies only. | Team leaders should assign one person to confirm quantities with warehouse staff. | For sealed boxes, use the quantity on the label unless the seal is damaged.

vocabulary.note: 實際核對庫存品項與數量的作業。
表示暫停後重新開始。

active.prompt: Which item should staff not request?
active.promptZh: 工作人員不應索取哪一項？

options.text: Do not request passwords for ordinary cases, but ask for them after an unexpected shutdown.
options.zh: 一般案件不要索取密碼，但發生意外關機時可要求提供。
options.whyZh: 禁止索取密碼沒有例外；意外關機時可有條件要求的是事件記錄。

options.text: Never request event logs, even when an unexpected shutdown log can be exported safely.
options.zh: 一律不要索取事件記錄，即使意外關機的記錄可以安全匯出。
options.whyZh: 意外關機而且能安全匯出時，應另外要求事件記錄。

options.text: Never request passwords; for an unexpected shutdown, request the event log if it can be exported safely.
options.zh: 一律不可索取密碼；遇到非預期關機，若事件記錄能安全匯出，就請客戶提供。
options.whyZh: 密碼一律不能要求；事件記錄不像密碼，在意外關機且能安全匯出時要另外收集。

options.text: Do not request serial numbers if a shutdown log is available.
options.zh: 可取得關機記錄時，不要再要求序號。
options.whyZh: 裝置序號是每件案件都要有的基本資料，不因另有事件記錄而省略。

active.explanationZh: 密碼一律不能要求；事件記錄不像密碼，在意外關機且能安全匯出時要另外收集。
active.evidence: Starting next week, all technical support cases must include the device serial number, software version, and steps taken before the problem occurred. | Do not ask customers to send passwords. | For cases involving unexpected shutdowns, also request the event log if it can be exported safely.

vocabulary.note: 用來追蹤使用者問題與處理過程的紀錄。
逐步說明如何使用系統或完成流程。

options.text: Bicycle maintenance, including replacing damaged parts without outside help.

options.text: Basic bicycle checks and adjustments, plus deciding when a repair needs an expert.
